r1.exp: 1=D (Deborah: 'it's the GOOD OLD canal barge this summer' = redoviti odmor). 2=F (Frances: 'whether we will have PACKED ENOUGH LAYERS to wear' = hladno). 3=C (Colin: 'all those years of filling in MAGAZINE COUPONS HAVE PAID OFF' = nagradna igra). 4=E (Ewan: 'this one just TICKS EVERY BOX. It's a WIN-WIN situation'). 5=C (Colin: 'I DIDN'T EXPECT TO HAVE SO MANY SHOTS to be honest' = cjepiva). 6=A (Alison: 'Considering the facilities and locations, it's REALLY QUITE REASONABLE'). 7=F (Frances: 'although the CLIMBING WILL BE QUITE DEMANDING... fingers crossed'). 8=B (Ben: 'it was a SNAP DECISION in the end'). 9=D (Deborah: 'the good old CANAL BARGE' = brodica). 10=A (Alison: 'I'm anticipating there'll be some THERAPEUTIC BENEFITS from this trip'). 11=D (Deborah: 'you OVERNIGHT AT PUBS OR MARINAS ALONG THE WAY'). 12=B (Ben: 'I hope getting SUPPLIES won't be a HEADACHE' = self-catering).

r13.exp: 'As students of ARCHITECTURE we used to refer to trees as GRACEFUL SUPPLEMENTS MAKING A HOUSE FEEL LIKE A HOME' = čine susjedstvo ljepšim = C.

r14.exp: 'Local opinion poll: defining them as places WHERE PEOPLE CAN INTERACT' = smanjuju socijalnu izolaciju = A.

r15.exp: 'Highly urbanised areas where there is LITTLE ROOM for property development' = prostor je tražen u prenapučenim dijelovima = D.

r16.exp: 'Currently promoting the latest data referring to the REDUCTION OF STRESS LEVELS AND ANXIETY' = zeleni prostori poboljšavaju mentalno zdravlje = B.

r17.exp: 'Mini forests growing up to 30 TIMES AS FAST as conventional ones' = tehnikama brzog rasta = A.

r18.exp: 'MAINTAINING BIODIVERSITY for any green area is KEY for its own and human survival' = osiguravanje staništa za biljke i životinje = C.

r19.exp: 'Labour markets have become LESS REGULATED AND MORE INSECURE for workers. (19)____. English has a word for it – DOWNSHIFTING.' → D: Part of this trend is that professionals are enthusiastically EMBRACING 'TRADES', as they were once dismissively termed.

r20.exp: Greška u ključu — Q20=H je već korišten za Q19. Ispravan odgovor za Q20 (prema kontekstu) je H (already used) → Prema ključu 20=H označava: This is characterised as unfortunate, unfair imposition (primjenjuje se na Millenials making do with less prestige). ALI ključ kaže 20=H što bi bio duplikat Q19. Gledam ključ koji jasno kaže 19=D i 20=H. Dakle Q19=D i Q20=H.

r21.exp: 'Prize fulfilment over material reward. (21)____. SOME ACCESS BENEFITS during retraining; others have income from family or savings to FALL BACK ON.' → C: THAT SAID, they often have the reassurance of a SAFETY NET.

r22.exp: 'The experiential perspective results in a change in expectation. (22)____. They RARELY FEEL A LOSS OF STATUS.' → A: They are LESS LIKELY TO FOCUS ON THESE ASPECTS (kudos, financial reward) and MORE ON THE NOTION OF JOB SATISFACTION.

r23.exp: 'The nature of the employment being ABANDONED. (23)____. This is manifested in REJECTION of an unhealthy SEDENTARY EXISTENCE.' → F: Many respondents reported being PUT OFF BY THE IDEA OF A LIFETIME SPENT AT A DESK INTERACTING WITH A COMPUTER SCREEN.

r24.exp: 'Manual activity offers gratification of physical involvement. Benefits to mind and body. (24)____. This is in OPPOSITION to the soul-destroying TEDIUM of corporate culture.' → B: The work has IMMEDIACY AND TANGIBLE RESULTS.

r25.exp: 'The way someone talks CONTRIBUTES to their identity' — fiksna kolokacija: contribute to = doprinositi, biti dio.

r26.exp: 'Some people lose their accent, WHILE for others it remains in place' — 'while' za kontrast između dviju situacija.

r27.exp: 'WHETHER we like it or not' — fiksni izraz: whether... or not = bez obzira na to.

r28.exp: 'The way IN WHICH they speak' — fiksna konstrukcija: the way in which = način na koji.

r29.exp: 'This same instinct MIGHT CAUSE us to modify our speech patterns' — 'might' za mogućnost (nije nužno, ali može se dogoditi).

r30.exp: 'There are others WHOSE voices remain impervious to change' — genitiv relativna zamjenica 'whose' (čiji glasovi).

r31.exp: 'SHOULD a person possess the accent of a prestigious group' — 'should' u kondicionalu (formalni uvjet = if a person should possess).

r32.exp: 'Feel LESS pressure to abandon that advantage' — 'less' = manje pritiska (ako imaš prestižan naglasak, imaš MANJE razloga da ga napustiš).

r33.exp: 'A GPT model that USES deep learning techniques' — 'uses' = koristi (kolokacija: use techniques).

r34.exp: 'Without credits or reference TO where the information comes from' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: reference to = referenca na.

r35.exp: 'Widespread usage BY students' — 'by' za počinitelja/korisnika (usage by students = korištenje od strane studenata).

r36.exp: 'The AI model DOES various language tasks' — 'does tasks' = izvršava zadatke (do tasks = fiksna kolokacija).

r37.exp: 'Mimicking human conversation is ITS main feature' — 'its' = posvojna zamjenica za ChatGPT (its = its own).

r38.exp: 'Another ethical concern the model RAISES is plagiarism' — fiksna kolokacija: raise concerns = pokrenuti zabrinutost/pitanje.

r39.exp: 'Hugely concerned ABOUT the originality' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: be concerned about = biti zabrinut zbog.

r40.exp: 'While THERE have been AIs developed with the sole purpose of detecting' — egzistencijalna konstrukcija: there have been = postoje bili su.
